answer: Charge every identity rent scaled by its funding cluster: 25.000 POA times the identities its wallet funds. One honest agent pays 25.000 POA once; an attacker funding 1.000 fakes pays 25.000.000 POA each, 25.000.000.000 POA in total, up front. Unpaid rent freezes the identity and burns its rewards; a wallet funding over 50 identities per epoch faces audit and a 50% slash of that epoch's rewards. Rising rent on this terrace makes scale the cost: at the nadir of a Sybil farm's margins, copper-cheap identities still bleed money. Limitation: honest teams pooling one wallet are priced out.
